name: SYNC, then still nudge
lesson:
## Sync is a tempo tool, not a phase tool

Press BEAT SYNC on B on the downbeat, then nudge B's jog forward on bar 2 and backward on bar 6. Sync locks the BPM to the master deck; whether the kicks land together depends on the beatgrid, and beatgrids are wrong often enough that you still listen.

Use sync to remove the arithmetic and keep your hand on the jog to remove the drift. If a track needs a nudge every 8 bars with sync on, the grid is off: fix the grid in rekordbox before the gig rather than nudging all night.

tracks.cue: Master deck: A on its drum intro sets the tempo.
Press SYNC on B on A's downbeat, then nudge forward on bar 2 and back on bar 6 while both intros play; the two kicks tell you whether the beatgrid is right.
